summary: Kandi Technologies Group, Inc. reported via Form 6-K its investment in Hangzhou Xinchu New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. through a capital increase agreement. The company subscribed for newly issued equity for approximately RMB20 million ($2.9 million), acquiring 51% ownership. The target must meet revenue targets of RMB150m, RMB300m, and RMB500m for fiscal years 2027-2029, with buyback or compensation clauses if targets are missed. This appears to be a minority investment with performance commitments, not a full acquisition or special situation. The filing lacks typical special-situation triggers like a tender offer, going-private transaction, or strategic review.
